findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_llms_txt, define_term · Private data: check_mcp_server, agent_readiness_scan, check_wellknown_discovery, generate_llms_txt, get_visibility_index · Public sink: generate_llms_txt, define_term · Destructive: check_mcp_server.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_llms_txt, define_term · Private data: check_mcp_server, agent_readiness_scan, check_wellknown_discovery, generate_llms_txt, get_visibility_index · Public sink: generate_llms_txt, define_term · Destructive: check_mcp_server

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
